title: Canada Cannabis Store Counts by Province and City
subtitle: Licensed, open retail cannabis stores in Canada, from provincial registries
description: Aggregate counts of licensed, open retail cannabis stores in Canada by province/territory (13 rows, 4,030 stores) and by city (1,027 cities), as of 2026-11-20. Compiled by Where's The Weed At from provincial and territorial registries. Aggregate counts only. Live version and methodology: https://wherestheweedat.ca/stats . Source registries keep their own terms; see README.md.
